description: DWR Surface Water Supply Index Component by HUC is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. The Surface Water Supply Index (SWSI) is used as an indicator of surface water supply conditions in Colorado. The SWSI compares the total volume of water in a basin or sub-basin against the volume available in the same month of historical years. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Water. Its tags are huc, surface water supply index, swsi, component. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: DNR - Division of Water Resources. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
